a.label: AARO Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP, Volume I

edges.label: Volume I found 'no NDAs that contain information related to UAP' - contradicted by the Yankee Blue record
edges.note: Volume I page 30 states AARO found no UAP-related NDAs. The Department later confirmed that Air Force personnel signed NDAs over a fictitious alien-technology programme. The two statements cannot both stand as written.

edges.note: Volume I page 30 records interviews with five former Air Force officers who served at Malmstrom, Ellsworth, Vandenberg and Minot between 1966 and 1977 and defers the unresolved allegations to Volume II.
